## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend production build passes when frontend code changed.
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests where practical.
- [ ] No database, PDF, log, `.env`, real business data or generated release file is included.
- [ ] Storage, security and compatibility implications are documented.
- [ ] Commits include DCO `Signed-off-by` lines.

## Screenshots

Include screenshots only when useful and only with fictional data.
